newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NBP raises Oct reserve money target.
newsitem.headline: Polish NBP raises Oct reserve money target.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland, central bank, raised the average monthly reserve money target for October to 32.95-33.65 billion zlotys from 32.54-33.24 billion in September, the bank said in a statement.
The average monthly level of reserve money is the NBP's key monetary policy goal this year through which it strives to control broad money growth and price growth.
The realisation of the September reserve target will be announced after the next meeting of the central bank's open market committee (KKOOR) in two weeks.
